items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: You think George Lewis was good, isn't it?

ctx.x: Buddy Petit, myself, Earl Foster. And Buddy had a clarinet player that lived over there, too. His name was Fritz.

Oh, yeah. There was in the door Fritz that George Lewis talked about. Now, you're talking about a clarinet player. Oh, my goodness. You think George Lewis was good, isn't it? George says he was wonderful. He's great. I say you think George Lewis is good, huh? Sounds good to me.
He sounds good to you. But if you had to hurt Fritz.
